title: Immunocytochemistry of i3Neurons Support Protocol
author: Michael S. Fernandopulle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5wtg7en
materials: During blocking, make up primary antibody solution(s) in blocking buffer or 3 % BSA solution.
Gently rock at Room temperature for 00:30:00 .
Gently rock at Room temperature for 01:00:00 .

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solutions for fixation and blocking.

substeps.instruction: Make 15 mL of 8% PFA solution (7.5 mL PBS, 7.5 mL 16% PFA).

Make 50 mL of antibody blocking solution (3% donkey serum and 0.1% saponin in PBS) and filter sterilize. (Note: Triton X-100 or Tween-20 at 0.25% may be used as alternatives; concentrations should be optimized by the user).

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the i3Neurons in the 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Pour the 8% PFA solution into a liquid reagent reservoir.
Retrieve the 96-well plate (containing 45,000 to 50,000 cells/100 μl medium per well).
Slowly add 100 µL of 8% PFA solution to each well using an 8-channel pipet; do not pipet up and down to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes (longer times or cold incubations may be used depending on antibody requirements).

steps.title: Wash Cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Perform a series of PBS washes to remove the fixative.

substeps.instruction: Tilt the dish to one side and lower 8-channel micropipet tips to contact the wall of each well.
Slowly aspirate the PFA into a waste reservoir, leaving a small amount at the wall-culture surface interface if necessary. Aspirate only one column at a time to prevent drying.

With the plate tilted, slowly dispense 200 µL PBS onto the wall of each well, directing the tip toward the wall and not the culture surface. Gently rub the tip against the wall in a side-to-side motion to disrupt surface tension.
Gently rock the plate for 5 minutes.
Repeat the aspiration, 100 µL PBS wash, and rocking steps two additional times.

steps.title: Block Cells
steps.instruction: Apply blocking solution to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL to 200 µL of blocking solution to each well using the tilted-plate dispensing method described in the wash steps.
Add 100 µL of blocking solution to each well.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with the primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add primary antibody solution to the plate using the tilted-plate dispensing method.
Gently rock at room temperature for 1 hour or at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash and Apply Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody and apply secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the primary antibody solution (may be saved for up to 1 month if 0.02% final concentration of sodium azide is added).
Add secondary antibody solution using the tilted-plate dispensing method.

steps.title: Final Wash and Imaging
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and prepare for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells with PBS three times using the tilted-plate dispensing method. The second-to-last wash can contain Hoechst/DAPI dye for nuclear visualization.
Image cells in PBS or replace PBS with mounting medium if desired.
Store the plate at 4 °C.
